flags.message: CourtListener MCP sidecar was rate-limited (HTTP 429, 300/hour, ~9 minute wait) on this cell's first two search calls, so the forecast was made without any live CourtListener retrieval; the cell degraded to the provisioned inputs, fedcourts query, and the statpack. If many cells in this fan-out hit the same limit, the shared quota is the cause rather than any one cell's call volume.
